name: Ostovite Nest
description: A nest of bones resembling an ant hill contains countless miniscule scavenger vermin with vicious, acid-dripping mandibles.
disable: DC 18 Athletics (trained) to topple the mound and destroy it
reset: The hazard deactivates if there are no targets for its acid spew at the start of its turn. The hatchlings return to the nest, and the hazard resets. If damaged but not destroyed, the nest recovers 1d6 Healing Damage Hit Points per hour as the hatchlings repair it.
routine: (1 action) The hazard makes an acid spew Strike against the nearest creature.

generalAbilities.name: Skittering Surge
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature comes within 15 feet of the nest

Effect A mass of skittering ostovite hatchlings crawls all over the nest, spewing acid in all directions. Each creature within 30 feet of the nest takes (1d10+4) Acid Damage damage (Basic DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw). A creature who fails the save also takes 1 Persistent,acid Damage damage. The hazard then rolls initiative.
